reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. Our new system allows for real-time updates to water depth without freezing the game, ensuring a smoother experience while you shape your colony. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water Mechanics Revamped in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update to the water mechanics in Provincia! With our new system, water depth updates in real-time as you modify the terrain, eliminating frame freezes and enhancing your gameplay experience. Discover all the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
